checks.name: packets came off the endpoint
checks.why: every count and every percentile in this document is taken over these packets, so a run that collected none makes each of them an absence rather than a number, and loopback delivers nothing at all while the endpoint is idle

checks.name: datagrams went onto the wire
checks.why: the receiving end's loss figure is a fraction of what this end sent, and a sender that sent nothing makes a receiver that received nothing look like a radio that lost everything

checks.name: every captured sample was encoded
checks.why: a 5 ms frame is 240 samples and the endpoint delivers exactly two frames' worth in every packet, so the split is exact or it is not a split; the two counts agreeing is the proof, and audio lost here cannot be told apart by a receiver from audio lost on the air

checks.name: no packet left a residue
checks.why: there is no accumulator on this path because A1 measured that there is never a residue, so a residue is a finding about the endpoint rather than a tolerance; the population is the packets, because no packets leave nothing over just as convincingly

checks.name: every encoded frame became a datagram
checks.why: one Opus frame is one datagram in this payload format, so the two counts are the same measurement taken at two boundaries, and a shortfall is a frame the socket refused rather than a frame the radio lost

checks.name: the timestamp advanced by the frame's samples every time
checks.why: the RTP timestamp is a sample counter, and one that drifted with this sender's scheduling would leave a receiver unable to tell a late packet from a packet describing a later moment

checks.name: the socket refused nothing
checks.why: a refused send is this host's own doing rather than the link's, and a run with any of them is measuring a machine that could not keep the socket fed; the population is the frames encoded, because nothing offered is never refused

checks.name: no frames missing from the device position
checks.why: the device position of a packet must equal the previous position plus the previous frame count, so a gap is audio the engine could not hand over and its size is known exactly; the population is the frames captured, because a stream that delivered none has no holes in it

checks.name: the device position never went backwards
checks.why: a hole is audio that was lost and a rewind is a position stream that cannot be trusted at all, so they are counted apart and this one is not a tolerance

checks.name: encode p99 under a tenth of the frame
checks.why: a tenth of the 5 ms frame is 500 us, and an encoder under that cannot be the term that matters in a budget measured in whole milliseconds; p99 and not the mean, because a frame late once every hundred is a click a listener hears

checks.name: the endpoint carried the left channel's tone
checks.why: a packet count and a datagram count agree just as happily when the host was playing nothing, and a receiver that reports no underruns while playing silence has carried nothing either; 997 Hz comes out of the captured samples themselves

checks.name: the endpoint carried the right channel's tone
checks.why: the two channels carry different frequencies so that channel order is provable rather than assumed, and a right channel reading 997 Hz is what a fold to mono and a channel read twice both look like

findings: the endpoint delivered 480 frames per packet at p50 and the encoder took 240 of them per frame, so one packet became 2 datagrams of 81 bytes
148.8 kbps on the wire including RTP headers, at 200.00 datagrams a second
the sending thread ran as MMCSS Pro Audio, thread priority 18
